title: 查询生产批次及所属产线
objective: 用外键将批次与产线关联，再筛选产量。
statement: 列出生产数量不少于 300 件的批次及所属产线，依次输出 batch_id、product、line_name、quantity。正好 300 件也保留，每个批次一行。
knowledge: batches.line_id 指向 production_lines.id；产线编号唯一，因此每个批次能关联一条产线。
b 和 pl 是表别名；两张表都有 id，b.id 是批次编号、pl.id 是产线编号，关联条件为 pl.id = b.line_id。
quantity >= 300 包含边界。ON 描述两表按什么键配对，WHERE 在配对后筛批次；对这个内连接，数量条件也可等价放进 ON，但分开写更容易看出关系和业务门槛。
starterSql: -- 关联批次与产线，只保留生产数量不少于 300 件的批次。

hints.text: 先根据 line_id 找到批次所属产线，再留下件数达到门槛的批次。
JOIN production_lines AS pl ON pl.id = b.line_id 配对，WHERE b.quantity >= 300 筛选。
SELECT b.id AS batch_id, b.product, pl.name AS line_name, b.quantity FROM batches AS b JOIN production_lines AS pl ON ____ WHERE ____;

referenceSolutions.sql: SELECT b.id AS batch_id, b.product, pl.name AS line_name, b.quantity FROM batches AS b JOIN production_lines AS pl ON pl.id = b.line_id WHERE b.quantity >= 300;
referenceSolutions.explanation: 内连接沿批次的 line_id 找到产线名称，再由 WHERE 保留不少于 300 件的批次。每个批次匹配唯一产线，所以一个批次输出一行。

expectedFailures.sql: SELECT b.id AS batch_id, b.product, pl.name AS line_name, b.quantity FROM batches AS b JOIN production_lines AS pl ON pl.id = b.line_id;
SELECT b.id AS batch_id, b.product, pl.name AS line_name, b.quantity FROM batches AS b JOIN production_lines AS pl ON pl.id = b.id WHERE b.quantity >= 300;
SELECT b.id AS batch_id, b.product, pl.name AS line_name, b.quantity FROM batches AS b JOIN production_lines AS pl ON pl.id = b.line_id WHERE b.quantity > 300;
